name: Barbarian (Warcraft)
description_html: Uses the PHB barbarian. Affiliation: any. Knowledge (military tactics) is a class skill. Orc barbarians may rage one extra time per day (stacks with racial battle rage).
description_text: Uses the PHB barbarian. Affiliation: any. Knowledge (military tactics) is a class skill. Orc barbarians may rage one extra time per day (stacks with racial battle rage).

name: Fighter (Warcraft)
description_html: Uses the PHB fighter. Affiliation: any. Knowledge (military tactics) is a class skill. Bonus feat list expands to include: Pistol Whip, Battle Language, Close Shot, Defend, Expert Rider, Lightning Reload, Mounted Sharpshooter, Storm Bolt, Trick Shot, plus Bash and Sunder Armor from the WRPG feat chapter.

name: Rogue (Warcraft)
description_html: Uses the PHB rogue. Affiliation: any. Gains Use Technological Device as a class skill.

name: Sorcerer (Warcraft)
description_html: Uses the PHB sorcerer with Warcraft spell bans: no summon monster I–IX or planar binding (those belong to the warlock); many necromancy spells are restricted to the Necromancer (Alliance & Horde Compendium). See Warcraft Cosmology. Affiliation: any. Night elves who take sorcerer levels become high elves.

name: Wizard (Warcraft)
description_html: Uses the PHB wizard with the same summoning/necromancy bans as the Warcraft sorcerer. Affiliation: any. A night elf who becomes a wizard is stripped of night elf heritage and treated as a high elf.

name: Healer
description_html: New core divine caster (Wis; prepared). Hit Die d8; 4 skill points. Proficient with simple weapons and light armor. Spontaneous cure (good) or inflict (evil); neutral chooses at creation. Gains Healing (good) or Evil (evil) domain power at +1 caster level but no extra domain slot; no turn undead. Brew Potion at 1st; bonus item-creation/metamagic/Spell Focus feats at 5/10/15/20. Spell list includes healing rain, death coil, moonglaive, rejuvenation, second soul, and touch of life.

name: Scout
description_html: New core wilderness warrior (favored class of night elves). Hit Die d8; 6 skill points; good Fort/Ref. Simple and martial weapons; light and medium armor and shields. Track and nature sense at 1st; wild healing at 2nd; woodland stride, trackless step, uncanny dodge, trap sense, swift tracker, venom immunity, evasion; spell-like abilities include locate object (6th), locate creature (11th), commune with nature (13th), find the path (16th), and wind walk (20th).

name: Tinker
description_html: New core technological expert (favored class of goblins). Hit Die d6; 8 skill points; simple weapons. Bonus Technology feats at 1/5/10/15/20 (including Build Firearms, Build Siege Weapons, Build Small Devices, Build Vehicles). Scavenge and jury-rig devices; bomb-bouncing; coolness under fire; fire resistance progression; evasion/improved evasion.

name: Beastmaster
description_html: Horde or night elf animal companion prestige class. Full BAB; d12 HD. Animal companion and wild empathy; animal friendship; empathic link; natural weaponry; speak with animals; magic fang progression; scry on companion.

name: Druid of the Wild
description_html: Night elf/tauren nature prestige class. +1 divine caster level each class level; spontaneous summon nature's ally. Wild shape (storm crow → stag → nightsaber → dire bear → treant); green sleep; woodland stride; nature sense; trackless step; venom immunity; timeless body; dreamwalking to the Emerald Dream. Spells include roar, thorn shield, and force of nature.
